meta_title: How to Lighten a Photo | Free Image Brightener
meta_description: Learn how to lighten a photo online. Brighten dark images, fix underexposure, and enhance lighting instantly and securely in your browser.
subtitle: Easily brighten dark images or fix underexposed photos. Adjust the brightness intensity and download your enhanced photos instantly.

tool_workspace.description: Upload your dark photos and use the intensity slider to brighten them instantly.

requirements.intro: The slider multiplies the brightness of every pixel. 100% leaves the image unchanged, values above 100% make it lighter, and values below 100% make it darker.

rows.value: Good for slightly underexposed photos taken indoors or in shade. 150% is the starting value.
For very dark images. Bright areas such as sky or white walls can turn pure white and lose detail.

rows.label: Below 100%
rows.value: Darkens the image, which helps with photos that are too bright or washed out.

notes: Increase in small steps. If the brightest parts of the photo turn plain white, go back down a little.
Very dark night photos also contain noise; brightening makes the noise more visible.
Brightening does not change the background colour of a passport or ID photo. If a photo was rejected for a dark or grey background, it needs to be retaken.
Your file keeps its format: a JPG stays a JPG (saved at 92% quality), a PNG or WebP keeps its transparency.

how_to.title: How to lighten a photo
how_to.step1_text: Select or drag in one or more JPG, PNG or WebP images. Nothing is uploaded.
how_to.step2_text: Move the slider above 100% to lighten. Start around 120–150% and adjust.
how_to.step3_text: Click the apply button. One photo downloads directly; several download as a ZIP with the same settings applied to all.

items.q: How do I brighten a dark photo without losing detail?
items.a: Use a moderate setting such as 120–150%. Higher values brighten shadows more, but already bright areas reach pure white and lose their detail.

items.q: Can I make a photo darker instead?
Can I lighten many photos at once?
items.a: Yes. Add several images and they are all brightened with the same setting and downloaded as a ZIP.
No. The adjustment runs entirely in your browser.
